**Danmark** (Denmark) serves as the national geographic area and the overarching benchmark unit for all clinical quality indicators and standards evaluated in the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] annual reports [^src1] [^src3] [^src5]. Managed by the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]], the national data provides the primary comparison baseline against which regional and local healthcare clusters are measured [^src10] [^src16]. The reporting timeline for these national indicators spans from the 2016/2017 baseline year for incidence data up to the most recent 2024/2025 reporting period [^src17] [^src19].

### Epidemiology and Demographics
Nationally, the incidence of [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (AF) has remained steady at 3.7 per 1,000 inhabitants in recent periods (2023/2024 and 2024/2025) [^src16] [^src19]. In the 2022–2023 period, there were 19,671 incident AF patients and 134,810 prevalent patients [^src5]. By the 2024–2025 period, the number of [[praevalente-patienter-med-atrieflimren|prævalente patienter med atrieflimren]] had grown to 138,889 [^src18]. The average age at diagnosis for incident patients is 74 years, while prevalent patients average 70 years [^src5] [^src16] [^src19]. Risk stratification using the [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] score shows that incident patients have an average score ranging from 1.73 to 2.60 depending on the specific reporting year, with a significant majority (e.g., 60.21% in 2023/2024) scoring ≥2, indicating a high risk for thromboembolic events [^src5] [^src16] [^src19].

### Clinical Quality and Treatment Standards
Denmark's national healthcare system is evaluated against strict clinical standards. For [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]], which measures the timely initiation of [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]], the national fulfillment rate consistently meets or exceeds the ≥90% standard, reaching 91.5% in 2022–2023 and 91.6% in 2024–2025 [^src1] [^src10] [^src17]. Similarly, [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]] tracks the use of echocardiography within the required timeframe; the national rate was 79.2% in 2022–2023 and improved to 80.6% in 2023–2024, fulfilling the [[standard-80-percent|Standard: ≥80 %]] [^src2] [^src11]. Other diagnostic and monitoring indicators, such as TSH measurement ([[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]) and annual S-creatinin measurement ([[indikator-4b|Indikator 4b]]), also show high national compliance, at 83.2% and 94.3% respectively in recent periods [^src17] [^src20] [^src22]. Long-term adherence to anticoagulation at 1, 2, and 5 years post-diagnosis ([[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]]) remains robust, generally hovering just below or around the 90% target [^src3] [^src4] [^src12] [^src13] [^src17].

### Clinical Outcomes and Complications
Despite high treatment rates, national data tracks severe complications and mortality. The incidence of [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|iskæmisk apopleksi]] among newly diagnosed AF patients within one year was 1.1% in 2021–2022 and 0.8% in 2024–2025 [^src6] [^src7] [^src17] [^src23]. Data linked with [[danstroke|DanStroke]] reveals that among AF patients admitted with ischemic stroke, a significant proportion (65.8% to 67.3%) were already on oral anticoagulation prior to admission, highlighting areas for clinical review [^src6] [^src23]. The rate of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|intrakraniel blødning]] within one year of diagnosis was 0.7% in 2021–2022 [^src7]. Mortality remains a critical focus: the 1-year mortality rate for newly diagnosed patients was 13.1% in 2021–2022 and 12.5% in 2023–2024 [^src8] [^src16], while the overall mortality rate for prevalent patients during the reporting periods was 7.6% (2022–2023), 7.3% (2023–2024), and 7.1% (2024–2025) [^src9] [^src16] [^src18]. Additionally, the development of [[hjertesvigtsindikatoren|hjertesvigt]] within one year of an AF diagnosis affected 6.5% of incident patients in 2021–2022 and 5.8% in 2024–2025 [^src9] [^src17] [^src21].

### Regional Subdivisions
To facilitate localized quality improvement, national data is systematically disaggregated into Denmark's five administrative regions: [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] [^src5] [^src12] [^src14]. These regional subdivisions allow the RKKP to identify geographical variations in clinical practice, case-mix effects, and outcome disparities, ensuring that national standards translate into equitable care across all Danish municipalities and hospital units [^src14] [^src16].

## Claims

**Performance**
- Resultatet for Danmark for indikator 1 i perioden 01.07.2022–30.06.2023 er 91,5 % (95 % CI: 91,0–92,1) [^src1]
- På landsplan blev 92% af de nydiagnosticerede atrieflimren patienter med en CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥2 sat i oral AK-behandling senest 30 dage efter diagnosticering [^src1]
- Standarden på ≥ 90% er således opfyldt på landsplan og har ligget kontinuerligt over grænsen de sidste tre årsrapportsperioder [^src1]
- Danmarks nationale andel for Indikator 4a1 i perioden 01.07.2022–30.06.2023 er 89,1% (95% CI: 88,5–89,7) [^src1]
- Danmarks nationale andel for Indikator 4a2 i perioden 01.07.2021–30.06.2022 er 88,6% (95% CI: 88,0–89,3) [^src1]
- På landsplan fik 83,2% af patienterne målt TSH i perioden fra 5 måneder før til 1 måned efter diagnosen atrieflimren [^src1]

**Clinical**
- Nationalt blev Indikator 2 opfyldt af 79,2 % (95 % CI: 78,6–79,8) af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren i perioden 1. juli 2022 – 30. juni 2023 [^src1]
- I alt 10.010 patienter i Danmark startede antikoagulationsbehandling inden for 4 måneder før diagnose eller inden for 30 dage efter udskrivelse [^src1]
- I Danmark var 65,8 % af atrieflimren-patienter, der blev indlagt med iskæmisk apopleksi eller apopleksi af ukendt type, allerede på oral AK-behandling inden for 100 dage før indlæggelsen [^src1]
- Den nationale andel af atrieflimren-patienter med iskæmisk apopleksi i perioden 01.07.2022–30.06.2023 var 0,6 % (95 % CI: 0,5–0,6) ifølge DanStroke-data [^src1]
- Nationalt blev 80,6 % af nydiagnosticerede atrieflimren-patienter undersøgt med ekkokardiografi inden for tidsrammen, hvilket opfylder standarden på ≥ 80% [^src1]

**Healthcare-statistic**

- Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som dør inden for 1 år i Danmark, er 13,1 % (95 % CI: 12,6–13,5) for perioden 01.07.2021–30.06.2022 [^src1]
